rows.reply: I'm really sorry you've been waiting two weeks without an answer and were spoken to rudely at the centre; that shouldn't have happened, and I understand why you're angry. Online batches are generally non-refundable, including when a student changes their mind, so I can't promise a refund here [RF-1]. Your refund request will be reviewed personally by a support agent, who will check your order against the policy and reply with a decision; PW aims to resolve support queries within 7 days [RF-4]. Your complaint about the staff behaviour also needs a support agent to handle it personally [CT-3]. Please reply with your order ID and registered mobile number so the agent can review everything quickly, and if this isn't resolved through support, you can escalate by writing to support@pw.live with your ticket details [CT-5]. For the crashing, if it's happening in the PW app, try updating it, clearing its cache (Android: Settings > Apps > Physics Wallah > Storage), restarting your phone and reinstalling if needed [TS-3].

rows.text: How to ask for doubts? I am not sure. Pls help
rows.note: Written blind by Arnav. Topics as written: Academic doubt. Why: User wants to know the process of asking doubts.
rows.reply: Happy to help you get your doubts answered! The fastest way is AI Guru, the AI help tool in the PW app, where you can type your question, speak it, or upload a photo of the problem in Hindi, English or Hinglish [AD-1]. During a live class, you can post doubts through the doubt option in the class, and the Smart Doubt Engine answers them instantly with text or short video explanations [AD-2]. Power Batch students also get 1:1 teacher interaction, and Vidyapeeth and Pathshala students can get in-person doubt help at their centre [AD-5].
